test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question: The greater intent behind Blind Opera is to:

options.text: establish a drama school on the lines of Shantiniketan
bring the disabled into the mainstream
showcase the talent of the visually challenged
popularise the plays of Rabindranath Tagore

solution:
​The correct answer is '**bring the disabled into the mainstream'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given passage is about a theatre group called the Blind Opera, which is the only theatre group in India as well as Asia, where all the members are blind.
 
• THe passage demonstrates how the members of this theatre group refuse to be marginalised because of their visual impairment. 
 
• Instead they have turned their disability into an asset and have utilised theatre as the medium for expression of their creative urges.
 
• The passage states that this exercise is not only for their individual benefit but also for the community as a whole. 
 
• The following line from the passage states - ***'There is also a greater purpose behind it: to use theatre to build a community and mainstream the huge number of disabled living in isolation. '***
 
• From this line we can infer that *The greater intent behind Blind Opera is to **bring the disabled into the mainstream.***
 
• Thus, **option 2 **is the correct answer.
